clips.title: The story
paras: The Bag of Empty Ooze Containers is a set of sterile glassware supplied by the gnome researcher Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge. Prepared for delicate field collection, it holds empty sample jars intended to capture pristine, uncorrupted slime specimens across Azeroth.

While investigating the bizarre biology of Azeroth's oozes, Laris Geardawdle realized that slime creatures rapidly absorb and mirror the corruption of their surroundings. Having studied tainted residues from places like Felwood, the gnome scientist commissioned these robust sample jars to withstand acidic specimens while preserving their natural state. The satchel holds enough jars for an explorer to gather clean, unpolluted slime from wild, untouched regions—most notably the primordial wilderness of Un'Goro Crater, where ancient glutinous oozes thrive free from demonic taint.
